description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate either Urza or Leyline of Abundance's abilities.
